title: give the UI pass a pre-approved way to render views outside the tree, such as a scratch copy of the module or an ANSI strip into TMPDIR, so it can produce the 120x40 and ASCII renders

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261117-233555-6d1c, project ork, item S390:
give the UI pass a pre-approved way to render views outside the tree, such as a scratch copy of the module or an ANSI strip into TMPDIR, so it can produce the 120x40 and ASCII renders
Evidence: rsync of the worktree into tmp/ui-1/mod and sed on a golden were both denied for lack of an approval surface, so only the two 80x24 goldens could be copied by hand

Merged cases (2026-11-18 duplicate sweep):

- S422 (run ork-20261118-035228-7421, S403): `RENDER_DIR=... go test` and an awk width check were denied as "contains multiple operations"; a `go test -overlay` file with a hardcoded path in the role's tmp dir worked. Wanted: the brief says renders come from an overlay file in the tmp dir.
- S425 (run ork-20261118-120855-7418, S405): `go -C WORKTREE run ./cmd/ork tracking commit --help` was denied, so the CLI help could not be rendered for the approval card.
- Retired earlier as duplicates: S426 and S429 (cp of the module into tmp/ui-1 denied), S433 (a named render hook; that pass used `go test -overlay` with a temp test file calling `launchHarness`, `launchConfirmed` and `plainView`), S441 (`mkdir -p ... && go test -overlay ...` denied; a plain `go -C ... test -overlay ...` ran).

Evidence (checked 2026-11-18):

- A cloud UI pass runs on an allowlist, not plan mode (adj 372, `roles.ui-pass-write-mechanism`; adj 374 adds Skill): `engine.LocalReadOnlyAllowlist()` plus Skill plus Edit and Write under its temp dir, with `--permission-prompts none` (`internal/daemon/runner.go:48-55`, `internal/agent/claude/args.go:100-134`). The list has `Bash(go test*)` and `Bash(go -C * test*)` (`internal/engine/perm.go:23-34`), so a plain `go -C WT test -overlay FILE ...` is allowed today; `cp`, `rsync`, `sed`, `awk`, an env prefix, `go run` and any compound are not.
- The UI prompt says to render "with the project's own tooling (its AGENTS.md, its UI tests and view snapshots say how)" and that ork has no render code (`internal/roles/prompts/ui.md:53-72`). ork's AGENTS.md names only `go test ./internal/tui -update` for goldens (`AGENTS.md:98-99`), which writes to the tree. Nothing tells the pass the overlay route, that helper files go in its temp dir by the Write tool, or that each shell call must be one plain command.
- For a cloud Claude UI pass the Done-when list adds no command rules (`internal/engine/brief.go:250-256`): the "Allowed forms" line goes only to write roles.
- The test helpers a render needs exist: `plainView` (`internal/tui/tui_test.go:214`), `launchHarness` (`internal/tui/launch_test.go:70`).

Open owner question: `roles.ui-pass-render-path`. The steps below are written for the recommended answer (document the overlay route; no new permission).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/roles/prompts/ui.md:19-23` (helper files in {{temp_dir}} by the Write tool; one plain command per shell call)
- `internal/roles/prompts/ui.md:53-72` (Renders: a render may come from a test file outside the tree, such as a Go `-overlay` file in {{temp_dir}})
- `internal/roles/roles_test.go:662-700` (`TestUIPrompt`)
- `internal/engine/brief.go:250-256` (`doneWhen`: a cloud Claude UI pass gets its allowed forms)
- `internal/engine/brief_test.go`
- `AGENTS.md:94-100` (Project Commands: the UI pass render recipe for this project)
- `docs/design.md` (UI pass renders)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestUIPromptNamesTheOutOfTreeRenderRoute` in `internal/roles/roles_test.go`: `ui.md` says helper files go in {{temp_dir}} and are written with the Write tool, that each shell call is one plain command (no `&&`, `;`, pipe or env prefix), and that a render may come from a test file outside the tree (it names `-overlay`). Red today: the prompt says none of this (`internal/roles/prompts/ui.md:19-23,53-72`).
- `TestCloudUIPassDoneWhenListsItsAllowedForms` in `internal/engine/brief_test.go`: a brief for role ui, vendor claude, `ReadOnly` true, has a Done-when item that names the allowed forms and says other commands are denied. Red today: the read-only branch adds only the Grok text (`internal/engine/brief.go:250-256`).
- `TestUIPromptHasNoOrkPaths` stays green: the prompt names no ork path (the recipe lives in ork's AGENTS.md).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests and see each red for the stated reason.
2. Per the owner's answer to `roles.ui-pass-render-path`. For the recommended answer:
3. `ui.md`: in the rules, helper files (an overlay map, a render test) go in {{temp_dir}} and are written with the Write tool; each shell call is one plain command, with no `&&`, `;`, pipe, redirect or env prefix. In Renders: when the project's tooling renders only through its tests, a render may come from a test file kept outside the tree (for Go, `go -C {{worktree}} test -overlay FILE -run NAME ./PKG`, with the test writing into {{temp_dir}}/renders/ by an absolute path). Keep the prompt free of ork paths.
4. `doneWhen`: for a cloud Claude UI pass (`in.Role == RoleUI`, vendor claude, read-only), add the "Allowed forms" item built from `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist()` plus Skill and the temp dir writes, the same list `claudeRunner.Run` sends (`internal/daemon/runner.go:48-55`). Keep one source for the list.
5. ork's `AGENTS.md`, Project Commands: the UI pass render recipe for this repo: an overlay test in `internal/tui` that uses `plainView` and the harness helpers at 80x24, 120x40 and ASCII, and the CLI help through the `internal/cli` usage text in a test, not `go run`.
6. Docs: `docs/design.md` (UI pass renders: the out-of-tree route, no new permission, adj record). Changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S416 --text "..."`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- The UI prompt tells the pass to write helper files in its temp dir with the Write tool, to run one plain command per call, and that a render may come from a test file outside the tree.
- A cloud Claude UI pass's brief lists the command forms it may run.
- ork's AGENTS.md gives the render recipe for this repo, including 120x40, ASCII and CLI help renders.
- No permission is added to the UI pass allowlist.

Commands:
- `go test ./internal/roles ./internal/engine -run 'TestUIPrompt|TestCloudUIPassDoneWhenListsItsAllowedForms' -v`
- `rg -n "overlay" AGENTS.md internal/roles/prompts/ui.md`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.
